description: Google and the Government of Telangana on Wednesday inaugurated the Google for Startups Hub at T-Hub in Hyderabad, marking a step to strengthen the state’s startup ecosystem. The Hub, the first of its kind in Telangana, is aimed at supporting AI-first startups by providing mentorship, technology infrastructure, and access to venture investors, along with connections to global markets.The Hub is part of Google’s global network of startup support initiatives and will offer selected startups year-long coworking spaces, hands-on guidance from Google experts, and visibility through its international platform. The partnership between Google and the Telangana government is intended to enable founders from Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities, women entrepreneurs, and university innovators to access world-class resources without relocating.Speaking at the launch, Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy said the initiative would lay the foundation for a globally competitive innovation ecosystem in the state. “Ideas conceived in Hyderabad will now have mentorship, technology, and market access to scale globally. Telangana is poised to become a launchpad for startups built here, for India, and for the world,” he said.Minister for IT and Industries D. Sridhar Babu described the Hub as an expansion of the state’s innovation ecosystem, noting that it would provide startups with tools, mentorship, and platforms to experiment, scale, and compete internationally. Sanjay Kumar, Special Chief Secretary for IT, Electronics & Communications, said the Hub reflected Telangana’s policy vision of leveraging technology, talent, and global collaboration to drive innovation.Google India Country Manager Preeti Lobana said the Hub would empower founders with AI capabilities, technical expertise, and mentorship. “The Hyderabad Hub will nurture talent and act as an innovation flywheel, helping Indian founders use AI to solve real-world challenges and build responsibly for India and the world,” she said.The Hub is expected to host networking events, workshops, and mentorship sessions for startups, providing them with access to technology and investor networks while supporting the growth of AI-driven ventures across India. The initiative underscores Telangana’s ambition to position itself as a leading destination for innovation and entrepreneurship in the country.
